units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 13</cite> <he>קפצה ק׳ לפני כסא וכ׳</he> Prosecution sprang up before the throne of glory, and spoke &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:29">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> end <he>אחד מלמד ק׳ שלו וכ׳</he> one pleads for his prosecution (proving him guilty), and the other for the defence; <he>אבל הקב״ה … והוא מלמד ק׳</he> but not so the Lord, he defends and he accuses.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>אומרים ק׳</he> (not <he>רים …</he>), v. <cite ref="S00738"><he>קָטֵיגוֹר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, beg. <he>הגיע ק׳ שלהן לפני</he> the charges against them have come before me; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 112b:2">Keth. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>דור … ק׳ בתלמידים</he> in the period of the advent of the Messiah there will be prosecution (ill-will) against scholars.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 2:3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. II</cite> <he>היו … קושרין ק׳ על משה</he> (not <cite ref="S00738"><he>קטיגור</he></cite>) the angels conspired to speak ill of Moses.
